source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The Windows Clang job supplies win64-clang and win64-clang-toolchain as its default aliases, while the toolchains project branch stays null. The assigned Clang 20 change adds the second alias to the same job; accepted Clang 22 configuration retains the pair. This configuration does not by itself prove upstream alias resolution, taskgraph execution or compiler compatibility.
title: The Windows Clang job exposes both stable toolchain aliases
